name: Dongguan Eontec Co., Ltd.
summary: Dongguan Eontec Co., Ltd. engages in the research and development, production, and sale of light alloy materials in China and internationally. It offers amorphous alloy products, notebook parts, and structural auto parts for use in the new energy vehicles, consumer electronics, medical equipment, communications equipment, and automotive equipment.
